items.summary: Legal/compliance disposition: conditional for bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate, and data-handling boundaries; blocked for unsupported monetization expansion, security-sensitive public exposure, and launch where required evidence is incomplete. Evidence: compliance baseline is technical only (37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown); analytics quality is yellow with source permission/collector errors; revenue is partial, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 that is not site-attributable. Do not treat incomplete telemetry or unattributed revenue as zero. Recommendation: containment-only execution; continue existing measurement, reconciliation, failure repair-or-close, security evidence, and launch-readiness work. No new production work, monetization changes, tracking expansion, external outreach, or go-live proposal is supported.

SearchWoot launch disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional only for internal, read-only evidence work. Official Woot documentation confirms API access, authentication, endpoints, and rate limits, but does not evidence redistribution, commercial/public display, storage, derivative, caching, alert, affiliate, advertising, trademark, image, price, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights. Current public terms point against the proposed public data product. Recommendation: keep the private gate, keep permission outreach unsent, and require human counsel before any rights-dependent request or launch decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for SearchWoot: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing progress is evidenced by official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

SearchWoot data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. The smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent and GA4 configuration without enabling new tracking; and produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No data-use item is clear or go-live eligible.

Keep scaffold and parked properties private or preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, configure analytics, monetize, alter DNS, or add credentials until dated owner, compliance, security, analytics, accuracy, measurement, and rollback evidence is attached. Continue the existing owner-gap records and record the next evidence artifact rather than creating duplicate work.
